gameDescriptionHtml:
Dead Grid is a turn-based strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, infused with an 80s retro vibe. Lead a squad of elite mercenaries, fight relentless hordes, discover survivors, and build up your camp with hundreds of scavenged upgrades.

Game Features

  • Go silent and keep the noise down, picking off enemies one by one.
  • Go loud with guns and explosives, drawing in the undead and wiping them out.
  • Set them on fire, blow them apart, and slice and dice in a perfectly orchestrated zombie funeral.
  • 15 mercenary characters, each individually voiced.
  • 5 classes with 115 unique skills.
  • Unlimited skill respec for endless experimentation.
  • 17 character attributes to fine-tune the combat style even further.
  • Challenge modes with Steam Leaderboards.
  • 350 Steam achievements, view progression directly in the game.
  • Find and upgrade hundreds of weapons, consumables and gadgets for your squad.
  • Discover unique items that enhance your skills and transform your playstyle.
  • Meet survivors to join your camp, where they’ll assist you in future missions.
  • Complete side 42 missions with bonus rewards.
  • Reanimate the dead to transform into a special class, called Revenant.
